summary: IDEAYA Biosciences filed an 8-K to announce a clinical collaboration with Roche to evaluate IDE892 (PRMT5 inhibitor) plus RG6505 (pan-RAS inhibitor) in MTAP-deleted RAS-mutant pancreatic cancer. No financial terms, equity stake, or per-share price were disclosed. IDEAYA sponsors the trial; Roche supplies RG6505. Each party retains full commercial rights to its compounds. The collaboration includes a joint governance process and optional future triplet with IDE397. This is a standard R&D collaboration disclosure, not a special situation. No tender offer, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other enumerated event is present.
